Bulletin No: 03 MWA/26/09/04/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 04 September 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 05 September 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar
and from Hambantota to Pottuvil.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via
Mannar and from Hambantota to
Pottuvil will be rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (50-60)
kmph.
The naval and fishing communities
who are engaged in fishing and naval
activities in the above sea areas are
requested to be vigilant in this regard.
